name: Dental AI Receptionist - Dedicated Test Inbound

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  c.id, 
  c.name, 
  c.slug, 
  c.timezone, 
  c.settings,
  COALESCE(c.id IS NOT NULL, false) AS is_valid
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN api.clinics c
  ON c.id::text = $1
  AND c.id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid
  AND c.active = true
  AND c.suspended_at IS NULL;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, code: 'PERMISSION', message: 'Invalid, inactive, or unauthorized clinic ID for test endpoint. Only Demo Dental Clinic (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001) is permitted.' }) }}

parameters.queryParameters: ={{ [$('Validate Test Clinic').item.json.id, $('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body?.provider || 'test', 'message', $('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body?.provider_event_id, 'hash-' + $('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body?.provider_event_id, JSON.stringify($('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body)] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, code: 'OK', message: 'Event already received and processed (idempotent replay).', data: { event_id: $('Register Inbound Event').item.json.result?.data?.event_id, duplicate: true } }) }}

parameters.queryParameters: ={{ [$('Validate Test Clinic').item.json.id, $('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body?.patient_name, $('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body?.phone] }}

={{ [$('Validate Test Clinic').item.json.id, $('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body?.dentist_id || '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', $('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body?.service_id || '2a9ecbee-5b32-43f4-a673-c119c67ad738', $('Inbound Test Webhook').item.json.body?.appointmentDate] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, code: 'CONFLICT', message: 'Requested appointment time is not available. Please choose another slot.' }) }}
